text: {"reply":"Hi {first_name}, thank you for your message. Your eGFR result was 84 mL/min/1.73m2. The lab's range lists 60 as the low end, so your number is above that. Your creatinine was 1 mg/dL, and the lab's range is 0.7 to 1.3, so it is within that range too. Your clinician can talk with you about what these numbers mean for you, including how they relate to the ibuprofen you take. Please don't change how you take any medicine until you hear from your clinician. If you have new or worse symptoms, you can book a visit or call the clinic."}
